name: Payghaam
summary: Payghaam iOS SDK — direct APNs push, identify, tags, events.
description: Native Swift SDK. Also distributed via Swift Package Manager (see Package.swift) for apps that integrate it directly; this podspec exists so CocoaPods-based wrapper SDKs (Flutter, React Native) can depend on the same implementation instead of duplicating it (the canonical native Payghaam SDK, kept in a separate repo: github.com/payghaam/payghaam-ios).
